movie.title: Ice Age: Boiling Point
movie.overview: A dinosaur-and-lava-filled madcap adventure takes Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Buck, acorn-obsessed Scrat – this time joined by Baby Scrat and the enormous Jurassic Scrat – and the rest of the herd to visit never before-seen corners of the treacherous Lost World.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Scrat, and the herd embark on a high-stakes journey into uncharted regions of the Lost World to face dangerous dinosaurs and rising lava threats.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In Ice Age: Boiling Point, Manny, Sid, Diego, and Ellie reunite with Buck to navigate an unexplored and increasingly perilous territory within the Lost World. As volcanic activity escalates and threatens to engulf the region in molten lava, the herd must work together to avoid ferocious prehistoric predators and environmental hazards. Meanwhile, Scrat's tireless pursuit of his elusive acorn accidentally triggers chaotic seismic events that complicate the group's survival efforts. Ultimately, the beloved companions rely on their enduring bond and quick thinking to lead everyone to safety.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The sixth main chapter of the beloved franchise brings Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, and the rest of the herd into an unpredictable new adventure deep inside the Lost World. When sudden thermal shifts and rising lava levels disrupt the subsurface climate, the group is forced to seek safer ground in uncharted subterranean regions. Joining forces once again with the wild, eye-patched weasel Buck, the team encounters unfamiliar dinosaur species and treacherous terrain filled with erupting geysers and bubbling magma pits. As Manny and Ellie try to keep the group unified, Sid attempts to aid local creatures, often creating comical mishaps along the way. Diego and Shira use their predatory instincts to defend the herd against fierce new rivals prowling the jungle. At the same time, Scrat and Baby Scrat find themselves caught in a chaotic chase for an acorn that unwittingly sets off massive volcanic reactions. Confronted with intense environmental obstacles, the herd must combine their unique strengths to outrun the advancing lava flows. Through teamwork, courage, and classic humor, they navigate the burning wilderness toward safety. In the end, the family proves that their unshakeable connection can withstand even the most extreme conditions.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In Ice Age: Boiling Point, the iconic prehistoric herd—Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, and their friends—enters the dangerous, uncharted depths of the Lost World. When extreme geothermal instability causes rising lava and catastrophic volcanic eruptions, the group must brave unfamiliar ecosystems filled with exotic dinosaurs, collapsing landscapes, and environmental traps. Guided by the eccentric dinosaur hunter Buck, the companions navigate a race against time to escape the heat, while Scrat's eternal search for his acorn adds fresh layers of chaotic comedy. Blending action, humor, and heart, this adventure explores themes of survival, unity, and family resilience in the face of nature's ultimate test.

story_structure.climax: Surrounded by spreading lava rivers and an impending volcanic eruption, Manny, Sid, Diego, and Ellie must pull off a high-stakes escape through a rapidly crumbling subterranean passage.
story_structure.conflict: Volcanic activity surges across the Lost World, causing massive lava flows and threatening the habitats of both the resident dinosaurs and the visiting herd, forcing them to find a safe way out.
story_structure.resolution: After narrowly avoiding the volcanic destruction, the herd safely exits the Lost World, reuniting stronger than before as they look toward new horizons.
story_structure.introduction: Manny, Sid, Diego, Ellie, Scrat, and the herd return to their familiar routines, but growing environmental instability leads them to re-enter the subterranean Lost World alongside Buck.
story_structure.risingAction: The herd navigates uncharted and increasingly dangerous territories filled with predatory prehistoric creatures and treacherous terrain, while Scrat's desperate quest for an acorn accidentally worsens environmental hazards.
